The [Color Matcher](/colors/) takes a list of colors as a CSV file, one row per color, and finds each one's closest Sherwin-Williams, Pantone and 3M 3630 matches. Fill in the template, save it as CSV, then drop it on the Color Matcher or press **Import**.

<LinkButton href="/templates/color-list-template.csv" download icon="download" iconPlacement="start">Download the Template</LinkButton>

## The Columns

| Column | What Goes in It |
|---|---|
| Name | What the color is, such as Logo Red. Optional. |
| Hex | The color: `#C8102E`, `C8102E` or the short `#C12`. A row without a hex code is skipped. |
| Notes | Anything for whoever reads the file. The Color Matcher doesn't read it. |

Only Hex is required, and Color or Code works as its header too. A file with no header row works as long as each row has a hex code, with the name before it.

## What an Export Adds

**Export** writes the same Name and Hex, then each library's match: its code, name, hex and match % for Sherwin-Williams and 3M 3630, the code, hex and match % for Pantone, and a last column naming any formula the office has on file. An exported list imports again as it is.
